Preparing for competitive exams or making time for daily reading? Our self-study space in Musapur, Samastipur gives you a place to settle in with your own books and study plan.

What makes a library right for you?

The best library for your routine is one you can reach regularly, with a comfortable desk and study hours that fit your day. At Silent Zone, you can compare the AC hall and individual desks, check the fees, and visit before deciding.

A study room for exam preparation

Use the quiet reading room for revision, practice papers and focused self-study. Bring your own study materials and choose from four-hour batches or a longer membership. See the batch timings and regular monthly fees.

How do I check seat availability?

Tell us which batch you prefer and when you would like to join. Enquire on WhatsApp or call +91 99424 19837 before visiting. An enquiry does not reserve a seat.
